title: Reconcile to the template release that ships the proposal and retire the project tool
goal: Reconcile to the template release that ships the proposal and retire the project tool
acceptance: Reconciled to the release that ships the fixes (10.20.1); the project tool keeps only what the shipped dashboard does not offer, with the reason recorded
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: reconcile, move the order format if it changed, delete tools/solution-overview*.mjs and their tests, refresh; depends on a template release that does not exist yet, so this can grow. 2026-11-25: the template plans this as project-harness F-095 (first part in v10.10.0: a step may wait on a step of another repository), F-096 and F-097; reconcile as each release lands, and retire the project tools when the dashboard covers them. Not a measurement. 2026-11-25 (reconcile to 10.20.0, with F-009-T01): the order moved to the shipped format (.solution.json order; N. repo:ID — note; this repository solution:) and both checks pass. The project tool stays: the shipped dashboard reads a step without a Who cell as Blocked and does not drop closed order items (B-001), docs/proposals/solution-order-in-template.md, Proposal 3. Remaining: retire tools/solution-overview*.mjs, their tests, check:order and solution:overview once a template release fixes both. 2026-11-25 (reconcile to 10.20.1): parity on the same component commits (overview against dashboard --remote): Blocked nerv 10 against 9 (was 61), solution order items Ready, runway 116.25 h against 117.25 h, Done order items shown ✅ Done and pruned by --prune-order (checked on a scratch copy with nerv:B-001 added). Retired: the overview's order pruning (pruneOrder, its test); the refresh now runs the template's dashboard --write --prune-order first, then the overview. Kept, as the owner's layout view the dashboard does not offer: tools/solution-overview*.mjs, check:order and solution:overview (Proposal 4 in docs/proposals/solution-order-in-template.md); F-004-T04 and F-004-T05 carry the rest. Actual stated, not measured.
